scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/worker build && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/web build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:pr && pnpm check:migrations && pnpm test
scripts.stack:smoke: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/worker exec node scripts/stack-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/worker build && node scripts/prepare-e2e.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:m1-closeout-stability: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/worker build && node scripts/prepare-e2e.mjs && pnpm exec playwright test apps/web/e2e/parity/m1-closeout.spec.ts -g "completes the M1 author loop" --repeat-each=5 --retries=0
scripts.test:e2e:update: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/worker build && node scripts/prepare-e2e.mjs && playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts
